items.exampleEn: Turn off all electrical appliances before you go on holiday.
items.exampleZh: 出門度假前，把所有電器的電源都關掉。

items.exampleEn: The rent includes the kitchen fixtures, such as the sink and cupboards.
items.exampleZh: 房租包含廚房的固定設備，像是水槽和櫥櫃。

items.exampleEn: A small stone statue stands in a niche above the front door.
items.exampleZh: 一尊小石像立在大門上方的壁龕裡。

items.exampleEn: Plastic utensils are not allowed at the festival this year.
items.exampleZh: 今年的節慶活動不准使用塑膠餐具。

items.exampleEn: Hang your wet socks on the radiator to dry.
items.exampleZh: 把濕襪子掛在暖氣片上烘乾。

items.exampleEn: Reading and watching TV are sedentary hobbies.
items.exampleZh: 閱讀和看電視都是很少活動身體的嗜好。

items.exampleEn: She poured some coffee from her flask into a cup.
items.exampleZh: 她從保溫瓶裡倒了一些咖啡到杯子裡。

items.sentenceEn: We bought a new washing machine and two other kitchen appliances.
items.sentenceZh: 我們買了一台新洗衣機和另外兩樣廚房家電。

items.audioEn: I always fill my flask with hot tea before a long day of hiking.
items.audioZh: 健行一整天之前，我總會把保溫瓶裝滿熱茶。
items.questionZh: 說話者健行前會做什麼？
options: Fills a bottle with hot tea

items.sentenceEn: Office workers often lead a sedentary life.
items.sentenceZh: 上班族常常過著久坐不動的生活。

items.sentenceEn: The cat loves to sleep on top of the warm radiator.
items.sentenceZh: 那隻貓喜歡睡在溫暖的暖氣片上。

items.stemEn: Please wash all the cooking ____ before you put them away.
items.stemZh: 把所有烹飪用具收起來之前，請先洗乾淨。

items.stemEn: She finally found her ____ as a teacher of young children.
items.stemZh: 她終於找到了自己的定位：當幼兒的老師。

items.passageEn: When Paul and Amy bought an old apartment, they decided to keep some of its original features. The lovely glass light fixtures in the hall stayed, and so did the small niche in the living room wall, where they now display a vase. However, the old radiators were so noisy that they had to be replaced. In the kitchen, they installed modern appliances and hung their favorite utensils on the wall. They furnished the rooms in an eclectic style. Paul works from home and admits he has become rather sedentary, so every afternoon he takes a flask of coffee and walks to the park.
items.passageZh: Paul 和 Amy 買下一間老公寓時，決定保留一些原有的特色。走廊上漂亮的玻璃燈具留了下來，客廳牆上的小凹洞也保留了，他們現在在那裡擺了一個花瓶。不過，舊暖氣片實在太吵，只好換掉。廚房裡，他們裝了現代化的家電，並把喜歡的廚具掛在牆上。他們用混搭風格佈置各個房間。Paul 在家工作，他承認自己變得很少活動，所以每天下午都帶著一瓶咖啡走路去公園。

questions.questionZh: 客廳牆上的小凹洞現在放著什麼？
Paul 為什麼每天下午走路去公園？
options: 他要去公園見工作上的客戶

items.promptZh: 浴室裡所有的設備都是新的。
referenceEn: All the fixtures in the bathroom are new.
Every fixture in the bathroom is new.
rubricZh: fixture 表示「（屋內固定的）設備」（例如 all the fixtures、the kitchen fixtures 等）
主詞與動詞要一致（例如 All the fixtures are、Every fixture is 等）

items.promptZh: 這間二手店專門修理老舊的家電。
referenceEn: This second-hand shop specializes in repairing old appliances.
The second-hand shop mainly repairs old household appliances.
rubricZh: 「家電」用 appliance 的複數（例如 old appliances、household appliances 等）
「專門」可寫，例如 specializes in、mainly 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：promptZh 只說「都是新的」，參考答案寫 brand new 加強語氣，略多於原文；可改 are new。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 參考答案改 Every fixture in the bathroom is new.，不加強語氣

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A：sedentary 單字卡「久坐工作讓人難保持體態」是保健說法（§11.30）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改成中性的「我的工作很少走動，一天大部分時間都坐著」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A 疑似 2：niche 單字卡教商業利基，不是居家單元的壁龕義
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依裁示第一義改「壁龕」，例句改「一尊小石像立在大門上方的壁龕裡」（與閱讀的客廳花瓶情境錯開）；雙義干擾項同步改格式；mcq 的「合適的位置」義保留

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：fixture 表示「（屋內固定的）設備」（例如 all the fixtures、the kitchen fixtures 等）／主詞與動詞要一致（例如 All the fixtures are、Every fixture is 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：appliance 表示「家電」（例如 the appliance I use most、a kitchen appliance 等）／句子要說到你自己家裡的家電

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長最終複審修正：最終複審 3：sedentary 新卡與閱讀、跟讀都是「工作讓人很少活動」，句型也相近
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 卡改成與工作無關的 Reading and watching TV are sedentary hobbies.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（appliance）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u12-l01-q16；目標字沿用 appliance
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「這間二手店專門修理老舊的家電。」、hintWords ["appliance"]、referenceEn ["This second-hand shop specializes in repairing old appliances.","The second-hand shop mainly repairs old household appliances."]、rubricZh ["「家電」用 appliance 的複數（例如 old appliances、household appliances 等）","「專門」可寫，例如 specializes in、mainly 等"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 appliance 造一個句子，說說你家裡最常用的一樣家電。」、referenceEn ["The appliance I use most at home is my rice cooker.","My most useful kitchen appliance is a small oven."]）
